title: The test
text: It's the weekend of his test. His karate grading is on Saturday, the judo club's regional competition is on Sunday, or he could skip them both and stay in his room, where nobody can see him.

choices.outcome: He gets his brown belt with a spinning kick the examiners still talk about.
Bronze. Grandma says he should have won, and he agrees.

choices.text: He stays in his room and watches old fights.
choices.outcome: He watches the same fights a hundred times, learning every move by heart, telling nobody.
